format_divergence.reason_en: Seventh of eight, unchanged reasoning: a receptive module has nothing for a transform or error-spot question to test. Only checkpoint 8 remains, so this is effectively the settled shape unless it is overruled.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What does the guest end up accepting?
questions.explanation_en: पानी चलेगा, बस — after refusing tea twice and being offered a smaller alternative.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What happened the last time he brought sweets?
options: They were kept for the children
They were sent back with him
questions.explanation_en: हमने आपको ज़बरदस्ती वापस दे दी थी — a fond accusation, not a complaint.

questions.question_en: Across the school dialogues, what is the picture of Rohan?
options: Struggling with the work and often absent
Fine at the work but not concentrating, and slow with homework
questions.explanation_en: पढ़ने में ठीक है, पर ध्यान नहीं देता — and at home, थोड़ा बाक़ी है two days running.

questions.question_en: A guest says इसकी क्या ज़रूरत थी while taking a gift, and बस बहुत हो गया while being fed. What are these doing?
options: Following a script where the protest is part of accepting
questions.explanation_en: Not making the protest would be the rude move. The same shape governs food, tea and gifts.

questions.question_en: In मैंने धोबी से धुलवा लिए, why से on धोबी and ने on मैं?
options: ने marks the arranger, से marks the one who did the work
से is required after any name
से is for people you pay
questions.explanation_en: The causative rule from Module 11 — the same shape as मैंने अमित से करवा लिया in the office.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: दोनों ___ के साथ रहते हैं आप?
questions.question_read_as: donoṁ ___ ke saath rahte haiṁ aap?
questions.explanation_en: के साथ is a postposition, so the plural goes oblique.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: लखनऊ ___ । वहीं का घर है।

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: और ___ आपको ज़बरदस्ती वापस दे दी थी!
questions.question_read_as: aur ___ aapko zabardastii vaapas de dii thii!
questions.explanation_en: देना takes ने — unlike लाना in the line before, which never does.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: दिवाली ___ घर आइए, सब लोग आ रहे हैं।
questions.question_read_as: divaalii ___ ghar aaie, sab log aa rahe haiṁ.
questions.explanation_en: Festivals take पर; ordinary days take को.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ऊपर वाले ___ में पानी टपक रहा है।
questions.question_read_as: uupar vaale ___ meṁ paanii ṭapak rahaa hai.
questions.explanation_en: में is a postposition, so कमरा goes oblique — and वाला follows it to वाले.
